svg.text: The same measurement, eleven times, on a listing that turns over
Every paper that ever clears two independent organisations, and whether it cleared it in each weekly capture.
11 weekly captures of the same listing
each sits at exactly two orgs
The same filter chain run on each capture gives 21 to 26 papers. 19 clear it every time, so stability is 67% — 19 of the 28 that ever qualify.
The cause is churn in the listing, not in the papers: 16% of model ids are absent from at least one capture.
A paper sitting at exactly two orgs drops out the moment one of its models leaves the ranking.
The fragile band is not noise to be cleaned up. It is the honest edge of a threshold applied to a population that turns over weekly.
Quote the core. A single capture's total is a number that will be different next week.
